title: foss-mcp product manifest
description: Per-product manifest describing a single ingested product: which family it belongs to, which platform it targets, the exact upstream repository it is built from, its ingestion schedule, and how its retrieval index is laid out. `schedule` is REQUIRED (plan 7.2) so that every product commits to a cadence rather than being ingested ad hoc.

platform.description: Target platform for this product build, e.g. 'python', 'java', '.net'.

repository.description: The exact upstream repository full_name (owner/repo), matching GitHub's own `full_name` field byte for byte. Exactly one slash; no leading, trailing, or doubled slash.

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression governing ingestion cadence.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name the cron expression is evaluated in. Defaults to UTC when absent.

storage_topology.description: How this product's retrieval index is laid out, e.g. 'single-index', 'sharded', 'federated'.

known_hazards.description: OPTIONAL (G3/TC-582). Project-authored, project-verified hazards for this product that the upstream repository does not document - e.g. a reproduced crash this project's own audit found. Never upstream content: each entry is written and verified by this project itself, and absent for every product with no such finding. Order is preserved; entries are served in this order.

text.description: The hazard, stated plainly: the real failure mode, its real trigger, and the safe pattern. Written and verified by this project, not quoted from the upstream repository.

verified_at.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) this project itself verified the hazard, e.g. by live reproduction.
